arc: hook (photo-tile ring spins in around headline, panel swings to the next lines) → feature (deck of model art cards, last one opens full-bleed) → benefit (tagline over the dissolving art, mark lands) → logo (mark + name lockup)

scenes.title: Spinning photo-tile ring with chained masked headlines
scenes.summary: Seven rounded photo tiles (whiteboard, factory, classroom, chip, Hubble, VR, microscope) sweep in along a huge ellipse, motion-blurred while moving, each angled to face the centre, around 'The best ideas'. The whole panel swings off left in 3D as a second panel swings in with 'Starts with a plan', whose words leave leftward; 'Same goes when building' slides in and pushes up out of its masks while 'Generative media applications' rises into the same slot, then exits right with blur. A deep blue radial field sweeps in from the left to own the last frame.
scenes.build: Tiles are positioned by ringPosition() on an ellipse (rx 700, ry 900) with an eased sweep and constant slow orbit; per-frame velocity (sampling frame-1) drives a per-tile SVG feGaussianBlur directional motion blur, and random() seeds per-tile yaw/pitch. Two panels cross with perspective translateX + rotateY; local SlideLine/PushUpLine components do per-word masked enter/exit. Blue handoff lives in an <Overlay> using BLUE_RADIAL from components/brand.ts.
scenes.reuse: Strong cold open for any 'ideas / real world' framing: swap the seven photos and the four lines. Steal the velocity-derived motion blur and the masked push-up line handoff separately. The blue push only matters if the next scene starts on the same field.

scenes.title: Angled deck of art cards, last one opens full-bleed
scenes.summary: On the blue radial field, four square generative-art cards slide in left→right one after another, overlapping like books pulled off a shelf, each yawed into depth with a thrown shadow and a white label: Gemini, Omni, Veo, Lyria. They float gently, then the first three slide out while the Lyria card grows and loses its radius until it fills the frame.
scenes.build: <Camera> with a slight zoom-out keyframe and drift; StackCard positions each card from a STEP_X/STEP_Y/STEP_Z rest layout, stagger() entrance, and lerps left/top/width/height/borderRadius to HERO_FRAME (shared in components/brand.ts) for the card-becomes-frame cut. Labels sit over a radial scrim.
scenes.reuse: Show a product family, model lineup or set of outputs as a card deck; swap images and words, change card count via PANELS. The card-opens-to-full-frame move is a reusable transition. Don't keep Google model names.

scenes.title: Tagline over dissolving art, mark springs in
scenes.summary: Opens on the Lyria art filling the frame, which slowly scales up and dissolves into the blue field with a pulsing glow. 'One model. Every medium.' rises out of word masks, holds, exits, and the white Gemini mark springs in above centre at the very end.
scenes.build: AbsoluteFill; hero art at HERO_FRAME fading out, a single <TextAnimation preset="riseMask" exit="auto"> in a <Sequence>, and a spring()-driven mark at MARK_SIZE/MARK_Y that scene 04 opens on unchanged.
scenes.reuse: Only as a handoff pattern (full-frame image → brand field → mark). The text beat itself is one line; write your own tagline.

scenes.title: Breathing mark over name on blue halo
scenes.summary: The white Gemini mark sits above centre on the deep blue radial field, breathing slightly while a soft halo pulses behind it. 'Google generative AI' rises in word by word beneath it, holds with a breathe, and exits.
scenes.build: AbsoluteFill with BLUE_RADIAL, a halo opacity tween, the mark scaled by a sine breathe, and <TextAnimation preset="riseMask" hold="breathe" exit="auto">. Mark position comes from shared MARK_SIZE/MARK_Y so it matches scene 03's last frame.
scenes.reuse: A simple, clean logo end card: swap the SVG mark, the name and the gradient. Don't ship the Gemini mark or Google naming.
